notes.title: Steam Anniversary Updates
notes.notes:
A little over a year ago, Who is the Red Queen released on Steam. Two years ago, Who is the Red Queen had its first release over on itch.io as part of the Spooktober Visual Novel Game Jam. Happy 2 years since Alice first fell into Wonderland!

To celebrate, we now have couple keychains available for Alice x Mad Hatter and Alice x White Queen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390325/756ea36ddf364aae7c06c6e978a0197990e5221b.jpg[/img]

You can find these keychains [url=https://vnstudioelan.com/store/Who-is-the-Red-Queen-c156728341]here[/url].

notes.title: Who is the Red Queen is out now on Steam!
notes.notes:
[i]Who is the Red Queen? [/i]is a horror fantasy lesbian visual novel developed by 4noki & co. that follows Alice falling into a strange and familiar Wonderland in search for the Red Queen’s missing pieces. As our third Bellhouse title, we’re excited to finally bring this to you! The game features over 30,000 words and has 3 major endings… with plenty of dead ends, of course. If you’ve already played the game jam version from itch.io, don’t worry- this is an updated version with new art, music, an updated script, and a Spanish translation!

[b][i]Can you find all of the dismembered pieces of the Red Queen?[/i][/b]

P.S. [i]Who is the Red Queen?[/i] is a dark fantasy game. There are 2d depictions of blood, gore, dismembered body parts, as well as written descriptions of the above. A full list of content warnings can be found on the game’s page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42390325/c6e21eee65d66b99886ad707138682b124aefd04.png[/img]








Stay up to date with our releases and other news on [url=https://twitter.com/vnstudioelan/]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@vnstudioelan]TikTok[/url]!

notes.title: Who Is the Red Queen? Coming August 15th!
notes.notes:
As we mentioned at the beginning of August, Who is the Red Queen? will be releasing on Steam later this month- and now, we have a date for you all! Join Alice on her adventure to a not quite right Wonderland on [b]August 15th[/b].

Who is the Red Queen? is a horror fantasy lesbian visual novel developed by 4noki & co. that follows Alice falling into a strange and familiar Wonderland in search for the Red Queen's missing pieces. As our third Bellhouse title, we're excited to bring this to Steam next Monday!

The game features over 30,000 words and has 3 major endings... with plenty of dead ends, of course. If you've already played the game jam version from itch.io, don't worry- this is an updated version with new art, music, an updated script, and a Spanish translation!

Can you find all of the dismembered pieces of the Red Queen?

Don't forget to wishlist the game if you haven't already!

P.S. Who is a Red Queen is a dark fantasy game. There is 2d depictions of blood, gore, dismembered body parts, as well as written descriptions of the above. A full list of content warnings can be found on the game's page.
